_readme: Text prompts for sam3_text_prompt.py. One entry per CONCEPT; each concept is prompted once per image.
The dataset's label space has two vocabularies from two annotated videos (see README §5c / HANDOFF):
JSR frames (file names starting 0-199-images__, 201-400-image__, 10000-10200-image__) use bot, bipolar, cut, endotracheal tube
JML frames (JML619-images__) use base of tongue, maryland, medial pterygoid muscle, parapharyngeal fat, ...
so a detected concept is written with the class NAME of the frame's source vocabulary ('class' below);
null = that concept is never annotated in that source, so it is not prompted there.
'prompt' is the free text given to SAM3 -- edit these to try better phrasings; keep 'class' as is.
Verified on the COCO train/val/test splits 2026-09-17: every class occurs only in the sources listed here.
